name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.34.1: real screenshots on the features page. Eight captures of the actual dashboard at 1440x900 and at phone width, taken by driving the real index.html in Chromium against the bundled demo fleet - not mockups, and with the real typefaces. Two things had to be dealt with first. The bundled 'demo' data is the REAL customer list (Airport Associates, Holaskoli, Newrest, Reykjalundur, Valhusaskoli, Valur, Keflavik, and the address Falkavellir 2), so every name is replaced with a generic venue label before any capture, by deep-replacing across the whole dataset rather than just the machine records - alert titles embed machine names, which is how three real club names survived the first attempt. Each capture is then checked against the original names and the run fails loudly if any appears. Second, DEFAULT_DATA.orders is empty by design, so the fleet read 0 kr and 'never restocked'; the capture seeds thirty days of plausible trading with a working-day hourly shape, and fills the today-sales globals the backend would normally provide. Those figures are illustrative and the page says so under every image. Reports is not captured: it reads from the backend and renders 'Backend offline' with empty tables in demo mode. Alt text now follows the language toggle. Cumulative over v6.34.
